"I think there is opportunity created by, particularly on the hardware side, the sale of hardware, where long lead times in GPUs and more expense creates opportunity for us," Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman told CNBC in an interview, referring to graphics processing units. Executives will announce a new relationship with Microsoft , one of the world's top cloud providers, on a conference call with analysts, Feldman said. The call starts at 5 p.m. ET. Cerebras has also landed deals with other major cloud providers Amazon and Oracle . Cerebras is evaluating its financing options to meet the ramping demand, Feldman said in the interview. The company is trying to challenge Nvidia in the AI chip market.
